newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade $112/dressed, up $1-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade $112/dressed, up $1-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis fully steady, USDA said. Dressed basis unevenly steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, with the steady sales often, but not always, in the central to Western areas of the state.
Demand was uneven, but fair-good on average, particularly for decreasing numbers of "old crop" yearlings. Seller interest good, particularly at the top side of quotes.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs - 68.00-69.50; dressed basis 110.00-112.00, few 109.00 (weighted average 111.29).
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - 68.00-70.00; dressed basis 110.00-112.00 (weighted average 111.23). Confirmed - 25,000 Last Week - 7,300 Last Year - 11,800
For week - 65,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 99,500 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 78,700
